newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 30.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN
- Ivorian cabinet approves plan to build 12,000 moderately prices homes in Abidjan. LE JOUR
- African Development Bank annual assembly closes in Abidjan. Governors note need for capital increase of 35 to 50 percent but talks to continue.

- Ivorian performing rights bureau plans system of validation stickers for audio cassettes to combat piracy. The same system is already used in neighbouring Ghana. (1$=580 CFA) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
